visual.veredicto: So say which factor matters most, and why

turnos.t: If SWOT and STEEPLE are so useful, what's wrong with them?
Three limits. Both are snapshots, and the situation changes. Both are subjective: two managers can classify the same fact differently. And they list factors without ranking them.
So how do I use them well?
Fill every box with case facts, then say which factor matters most and why. Match the boxes: use a strength to grab an opportunity, or fix the weakness that makes a threat dangerous.
